panel.bad_response: The provider returned an unreadable response
panel.response_too_large: The provider response was too large to read

settings.bar_coin_desc: Select the asset to display in the status bar
settings.color_scheme_desc: Select the color scheme for price changes
settings.config_import_missing: Configuration file was not found or is empty
settings.invalid_price_range: The lower price must be less than the upper price
settings.market_type_desc: Spot supports crypto pairs. Perpetual futures can display supported metals and stock contracts from exchanges.
settings.price_alerts_desc: Set optional upper and lower prices for each monitored asset
settings.proxy_tip: Leave empty to disable proxy. Format: http://host:port or socks5://host:port
settings.rapid_alert_desc: Notify when a selected asset moves quickly within the configured window
settings.search_placeholder: Enter an asset symbol to search (for example: btc, xau, aapl)
settings.static_note: Data source, market type, proxy and refresh interval come from the host settings; everything else is edited here.
settings.watch_empty: No assets yet - search above to add one
settings.watch_list_tip: Click an asset to add or remove it, and use arrows to reorder
settings.search_note: Availability is checked on demand; unrelated results are never listed.
settings.carousel_desc: Rotate the bar asset through the followed assets; the mouse wheel steps it manually and restarts the interval.
settings.carousel_follow_hint: The follow toggle at the start of each watch-list row picks the rotation; with none followed, the whole watch list rotates.
